newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DHL eyes replacement of B727 fleet in Europe.
newsitem.headline: DHL eyes replacement of B727 fleet in Europe.

text.p: DHL is considering the future of its Boeing Co 727 fleet in Europe, a DHL spokesman said.
The company has 28 727s, but due to concern over noise regulations and a need for more capacity, DHL wants to replace the fleet.
"We are trying to be good citizens. Our B727s have been hush-kitted and we are reducing the amount of air traffic by trucking into Brussels," he told Reuters.
DHL is looking for an aircraft with a 40 tonne capacity, double that of the B727.
Together with its shareholder Lufthansa Cargo, DHL is currently studying the replacement, but options under consideration are the Airbus Industrie A300 or A310 and Boeing's 757 or 767.
DHL plans to start phasing out the B727 next year, he added.
